reflect_en: Surrounded by enemies, David kept watch for God, his strength and his fortress, and trusted that God's loving devotion would come to meet him. Whatever you face this Tuesday, you don't have to face it alone or unguarded.
q_en: What are you facing this week that you need God to meet you in?
x_en: You, O God, are my fortress. My God of loving devotion will come to meet me
tiktok: God is my fortress 🙏 Psalm 59:9–10 — His loving devotion will come to meet you today
yt_title: You, O God, Are My Fortress | Psalm 59:9–10 #Shorts
li_open: Every leader eventually faces opposition they can't manage alone.
li_quote: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
li_body: David didn't rely on his own strength when he was surrounded; he kept watch for God and trusted Him as his fortress. Leaders who pray first, and invite their people to pray with them, can meet hard seasons from a place of security instead of fear.
reflect_es: Rodeado de enemigos, David esperó en Dios, su fuerza y su defensa, confiando en que el Dios de su misericordia saldría a su encuentro. Lo que enfrentes este martes, no lo enfrentas solo ni desprotegido.
q_es: ¿Qué estás enfrentando esta semana en lo que necesitas que Dios te sostenga?
x_es: porque Dios es mi defensa. El Dios de mi misericordia me prevendrá
key_en: You, O God, are my fortress
